title: COMBINED GEO-SCIENTIST EXAMINATION, 2025
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau UPSC COMBINED GEO-SCIENTIST EXAMINATION, 2025 प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                15 JUL 2026 8:56AM by PIB Delhi The Result of the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2025 was declared vide Press Note dated 29.10.2025 recommending 80 candidates in the order of merit for appointment. 2. The Commission, in accordance with Rule 16 (iv) & (v) of the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2025, had also maintained a consolidated Reserve List in order of merit below the last recommended candidate. 3. Now as per the requisition placed by the Ministry of Mines, the Commission hereby recommends 16 candidates which comprises 13 candidates (General-04 , OBC-07, EWS -01, SC-01) for the posts of Scientist ‘B’ (Hydrogeology), Group ‘A’/ Assistant Hydrogeologist, Group ‘B’ and 03 candidates ( General-02, EWS-01) for the posts of Geophysicist, Group ‘A’/ Scientist ‘B’ (Geophysics), Group ‘A’/ Assistant Geophysicist, Group ‘B’ for the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2025 from the candidates of Reserve List. A list of these candidates is enclosed. The Ministry of Mines will communicate directly with these recommended candidates. 4.
